verdict.rationale: YYLO documents an integration that brings Slack messages or GitHub issues into its kanban, and Ledger keeps typed task records with intent, status and blockers. That covers turning incoming requests into structured tasks. Nothing shows it treats these as user-feedback submissions or generates a proposed scope for each task. missing for 10: feedback-submission intake specifically, automatic proposed scope/spec generation, field-level detail on how imported items become structured tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope

citations.quote: Bring Slack messages or GitHub issues into kanban and return completed responses to their source thread.
Keep task intent, status, blockers and responses in Git-native records.
typed task, wiki, workflow, and artifact profiles
